title: 第25章以工代赈惊世骇俗的赈灾谋略第26章的确大胆连朕的腿也敢偷看
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: “以工代赈？”
伴随着高阳的一番话，整个金銮殿的群臣全都陷入了思考。
就连武曌的目光也扫了过去。
“何为以工代赈？”
大乾丞相徐玄机好奇问道。
高阳目光看向徐玄机道，“大灾年间，最底层的百姓没有银子，买不起粮食，但他们却有劳动力。”
“故此，臣斗胆提出翻修县衙，但其目的并不是压榨百姓，而是想让临江城内的各大富商看到，天灾之下，老百姓为了一口吃的，愿意十分低廉的干活。”
“一点点银钱加上管一顿饭，百姓便十分感恩。”
“若各大府衙，富商接连出手，只要临江城的粮价趋于稳定，那么就能令相当一部分灾民撑过去！”
“这便是以工代赈！”
随着高阳的一番话响彻金銮殿。
崔星河满脸震惊，丞相徐玄机满脸动容。
“好一个以工代赈！”
徐玄机毫不掩饰自已的夸赞。
这个思路，他们以往根本没有想过。
龙椅上，武曌一双美眸看向高阳。
高阳的这一番话给她打开了一个前所未有的思路。
朝廷并不只有赈灾一条路。
还可以以工代赈！
百姓处于天灾之下，为了生存，可以很廉价的出卖自已的劳动力。
这个做法看似对百姓残忍，十分毒辣，但实则却是一条救民之策！
武曌的目光带着惊叹，一双眸光充斥着满意。
王忠忍不住的沉声道，“可纵然是以工代赈，高大人何必如此压榨百姓，十文一天，未免太苛待了！”
大乾百姓一天劳作的收入大概在三十文到一百文。
这个工钱，已经压的很低。
足以堪称压榨了。
一时间，诸多目光齐聚高阳身上。
崔星河闭了闭眼，一言不发。
他只觉得这王忠太过愚蠢，这不是给高阳出风头的机会吗？
高阳回头看向王忠，嘲笑道，“王老将军若不懂民生，大可不必开口，适当的沉默并不丢人，总比贻笑大方要好。”
王忠闻言，满脸震怒，“高阳小儿，你敢辱我？找死不成？”
content_en:
“Credit for work?”
Following Gao Yang's words, all the officials in the Jinluan Palace fell into thinking.
Even Wu Zhao glanced over.
“What is relief for work?”
Daqian Prime Minister Xu Xuanji asked curiously.
Gao Yang looked at Xu Xuanji and said, "During the great disaster, the people at the lowest level had no money and could not afford food, but they had labor force."
"Therefore, I boldly proposed to renovate the county government office, but my purpose is not to squeeze the people, but to let the wealthy businessmen in Linjiang City see that under natural disasters, the people are willing to work very cheaply just for a bite to eat."
"With a little money and a meal, the people will be very grateful."
"If the major government offices and wealthy businessmen take action one after another, as long as the food prices in Linjiang City stabilize, then a considerable number of the victims will be able to survive!"
“This is cash-for-work!”
As Gao Yang's words resounded throughout the Jinluan Palace.
Cui Xinghe's face was full of shock, and Prime Minister Xu Xuanji's face was full of emotion.
“What a work-for-relief program!”
Xu Xuanji made no secret of his praise.
They had never thought about this idea before.
On the dragon chair, Wu Zhao looked at Gao Yang with his beautiful eyes.
Gao Yang's words opened up an unprecedented way of thinking for her.
The court did not only provide disaster relief.
Work-for-relief is also available!
People are under natural disasters. In order to survive, they can sell their labor power very cheaply.
This approach seems cruel and very vicious to the people, but in fact it is a strategy to save the people!
Wu Zhao's eyes were filled with wonder, and his eyes were full of satisfaction.
Wang Zhong couldn't help but said in a deep voice, "But even if it is work-for-relief, why would Mr. Gao oppress the people like this? Ten coins a day is too harsh!"
The income of ordinary people from a day's work is about thirty to one hundred cents.
The wages are already very low.
It's enough to be called a squeeze.
For a time, many eyes focused on Gao Yang.
Cui Xinghe closed his eyes and said nothing.
He just felt that Wang Zhong was too stupid. Didn't this give Gao Yang a chance to shine?
Gao Yang turned back to look at Wang Zhong and mocked, "If General Wang doesn't understand people's livelihood, there is no need to speak. Appropriate silence is not shameful. It is better than making people laugh."
When Wang Zhong heard this, his face was full of anger, "Little Gao Yang, you dare to insult me? Are you seeking death?"
title_en: Chapter 25: The shocking disaster relief strategy of using work for relief Chapter 26: It’s so bold that even I dared to peek at my legs
